purpose: Make the sealed metadata trust root mandatory at the evaluator boundary, not merely optional runner context.
requirements: Public promotion evaluator must require sealed metadata context; absence of a registered context fails closed. Do not silently skip receipt/metadata hash validation.
Load metadata hash allowlist and leaf bindings from a sealed registry owned by the replay/verification path, not from candidate, metadata object, evaluator options or any caller-provided allowlist.
Authenticate metadata bytes themselves before parsing their manifest. Bind registry entry to leaf ID, metadata file digest, raw source digest and permitted manifest digest.
Do not export any raw/pure function capable of returning VERIFIED without the registry check. If a low-level parser is needed, keep it internal and make it incapable of promotion decisions.
Add negative tests: direct public evaluator call with no context; forged metadata with correct raw SHA; caller-supplied validMetadataHashes; leaf substitution/path traversal. All must HELD.

Positive fixture must reference an immutable fixture registry entry whose raw and metadata digests are recorded in receipt inputs. Default verify-existing remains non-mutating and must verify registry digest too.
Use only existing sealed R3 bytes, retain 0 VERIFIED / 10 HELD, and do not hydrate/package/deploy/mutate scheduler, alias or rollback.
acceptance_gate: CEO verify-existing replay and mandatory trust-root review required; no automatic promotion
